polytune.note: hm_excess_over_null = (obs_off - null_off) / (obs_matched - null_matched): the misclassified fraction of the ABOVE-CHANCE matched mass. hm_simple_subtraction can be negative because chance co-locations are mostly misclassified (hm_null >> hm_obs); it is reported for completeness, not as the headline quantity.
